decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is close to the firm's core offer and was given more website prominence in 2019, so it carries low cost, supports many customer projects and still holds substantial option value.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's enterprise GIS business and kept its own page across both observed years, so its prospects remain open and keeping it costs little.

The search extension was still being developed in 2019 with a new version, suggesting ongoing use, though the firm's history of pruning small plugins (A, B, C) and its many other options give it a moderate risk of being dropped.
